name: Liquidity report transformation blueprint
steering: Do not change the primary branch; work on a feature branch.
Do not modify the protected acceptance suite.
Return an open decision when business authority is missing — never invent it.
controls: Keep reversal records in the output.
Keep the difference between expected input and output totals within 0.01 in the synthetic currency unit.
Keep entity, currency, maturity_bucket, and report_date populated.
Do not change the primary branch.
Do not modify the protected acceptance suite.
Return an open decision when business authority is missing.
acceptanceRules: A valid record has non-null account_id, report_date and amount.
Valid input and output record counts match.
No required owner decision remains open.
